question.text: "Extraction of gold $(\mathrm{Au})$ involves the formation of complex ions $X$ and $Y$ $X$ and $Y$ respectively are

solution.text:
Extraction of gold (Au) involves the following sequence of reaction,
$\begin{array}{l}
\text { Gold ore } \frac{\text { Roasting }}{\mathrm{CN}^{-}, \mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}, \mathrm{O}_{2}} \quad \mathrm{HO}^{-}+\mathrm{Au}(\mathrm{CN})_{2}^{-} 
\quad \stackrel{\mathrm{Zn}}{\longrightarrow} \mathrm{Zn}(\mathrm{CN})_{4}^{2-}+\mathrm{Au} \\
Y
\end{array}$
Hence, $X=\mathrm{Au}(\mathrm{CN})_{2}^{-}, Y=\mathrm{Zn}(\mathrm{CN})_{4}^{2-}$
